purpose: Activation class for the CURRENT skills whose canonical frontmatter declares no activation_triggers. A skill with declared triggers is always `conditional` and is never listed here. Each class is bound to a phrase quoted from the skill's own description; the generator refuses to run when the phrase is no longer present, so this file cannot drift silently from the source.

reasoning-doctrine.basis: The working method for every nontrivial task
reasoning-doctrine.note: Declared a standing environment skill by AGENTS.md in both source repositories.

governed-operator.basis: Full governance constitution for work that touches shared state
governed-operator.note: Declared a standing environment skill by AGENTS.md in both source repositories; its description also names what it is not needed for.

write-maintainable-code.basis: Use after outcome, scope, authority, and acceptance evidence are fixed

portable-adaptive-planning.basis: Use for planning, roadmaps, design, architecture, sequencing, or before consequential work

ship-it-or-fix-it.basis: Load ONLY when the operator explicitly sets Governance Dial G2

grilling.basis: Use when the user wants to stress-test their thinking

unslop.negative_scenario: the response is only a machine-readable JSON document or raw command output with no prose

cil-mode-switch.basis: automatically restore a CIL-conditioned operating posture across a session
cil-mode-switch.negative_scenario: a later turn in the same session with a trustworthy baseline and no explicit `Mode Switch` instruction
cil-mode-switch.note: Body: a full switch runs on an explicit `Mode Switch`, on a proven fresh-session entry signal, or when restore cannot establish a trustworthy same-session baseline. Pre-wiring source; it installs nothing and grants nothing.
